name: Protein Egg and Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the bread and mash avocado with lemon.
Scramble eggs with egg whites, then serve on toast with tomato.

name: Greek Yogurt Power Berry Bowl
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl and top with berries.
Add granola, chia, and pumpkin seeds just before eating.

name: Spinach Feta Omelette Plate
steps: Cook spinach briefly in olive oil.
Add beaten eggs and whites, fold with feta, and serve with cucumber.

name: Vegan Tofu Breakfast Wrap
steps: Crumble tofu and cook with pepper, spinach, and black beans.
Wrap in the tortilla and toast seam-side down.

name: Savory Cottage Cheese Breakfast Bowl
steps: Add cottage cheese to a bowl.
Top with vegetables, pumpkin seeds, olive oil, and pepper.

name: Oat Banana Protein Pancakes
steps: Blend oats, banana, eggs, yogurt, and baking powder.
Cook small pancakes and top with peanut butter.

name: Smoked Salmon Egg Breakfast Plate
steps: Scramble eggs and egg whites.
Serve with salmon, avocado, cucumber, and dill.

name: Overnight Chia Berry Oats
steps: Stir all ingredients in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight and stir before eating.

name: Turkey Egg Muffins with Greens
steps: Mix eggs, whites, turkey, vegetables, and cheese.
Bake in muffin cups at 190C until set.

name: Vegan Tempeh Sweet Potato Hash
steps: Pan-cook diced sweet potato until tender.
Add tempeh, onion, kale, and paprika until browned.

name: Ricotta Berry Almond Toast
steps: Toast bread and spread with ricotta.
Top with berries, almonds, and cinnamon.

name: Low-Carb Shakshuka with Feta
steps: Simmer tomatoes and pepper until thick.
Poach eggs in the sauce and finish with feta.

name: Peanut Butter Protein Smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Serve cold as a high-calorie quick breakfast.

name: Vegan Green Protein Smoothie
steps: Blend all ingredients until very smooth.
Add water if a thinner texture is preferred.

name: Chicken Sausage Egg Breakfast Bowl
steps: Brown chicken sausage with mushrooms.
Add spinach and scrambled eggs until cooked through.

name: Apple Cinnamon Quark Bowl
steps: Dice apple and stir into quark.
Top with oats, walnuts, and cinnamon.

name: Keto Breakfast Salad with Eggs
steps: Boil or fry eggs to preference.
Serve over greens with avocado, feta, olive oil, and lemon.

name: Vegan Chickpea Breakfast Omelet
steps: Whisk chickpea flour with water and nutritional yeast.
Cook with tofu, spinach, and mushrooms until set.

name: Mediterranean Tuna Egg Toast
steps: Toast bread and top with tuna and sliced egg.
Add tomato, olive oil, and parsley.

name: Keto Tofu Mushroom Scramble
steps: Crumble tofu and season with turmeric and nutritional yeast.
Cook with mushrooms, spinach, and olive oil.

name: Egg White Breakfast Burrito
steps: Scramble egg whites with spinach.
Fill tortilla with egg whites, beans, salsa, and cheese.

name: Halloumi Eggs with Tomato Cucumber
steps: Pan-sear halloumi and cook eggs.
Serve with tomato, cucumber, and olive oil.

name: Vegan Muesli Soy Yogurt Bowl
steps: Spoon soy yogurt into a bowl.
Top with muesli, raspberries, hemp, and flaxseed.

name: Keto Chia Almond Pudding
steps: Whisk ingredients in a jar.
Chill until thick, then stir before serving.

name: Lean Beef and Eggs Breakfast
steps: Sear beef strips and mushrooms.
Serve with eggs and wilted spinach.

name: High-Protein Bircher Muesli
steps: Mix oats, yogurt, protein, grated apple, and lemon.
Top with almonds and chill if time allows.

name: Low-Carb Egg Cottage Plate
steps: Scramble eggs and whites with spinach.
Serve with cottage cheese and tomato.

name: Vegan Cinnamon Breakfast Quinoa
steps: Warm quinoa with soy milk and cinnamon.
Top with blueberries, almond butter, and hemp seeds.

name: High-Calorie Egg Bagel Breakfast
steps: Toast the bagel and cook eggs with egg whites.
Assemble with avocado, cheese, and tomato.

name: Sardine Egg Mediterranean Breakfast
steps: Cook eggs to preference.
Serve with sardines, vegetables, olive oil, and parsley.

name: Vegan Black Bean Breakfast Toast
steps: Mash beans with lime and warm briefly.
Serve on toast with avocado, salsa, and pumpkin seeds.

name: Low-Carb Protein Waffles
steps: Whisk batter and cook in a waffle iron.
Serve with raspberries and yogurt.

name: Mushroom Goat Cheese Frittata
steps: Cook mushrooms and spinach in olive oil.
Add eggs, top with goat cheese, and cook until set.

name: Quick Breakfast Bento Box
steps: Pack eggs, yogurt, crackers, berries, almonds, and cucumber in sections.
Keep chilled until ready to eat.

name: Vegan Savory Miso Oats
steps: Cook oats with water and miso until creamy.
Top with tofu, mushrooms, spinach, and sesame oil.

name: Low-Carb Breakfast Lettuce Tacos
steps: Cook turkey and eggs together.
Spoon into lettuce leaves with avocado, salsa, and cheese.

name: Chicken Quinoa Meal Prep Bowl
steps: Layer quinoa, chicken, and vegetables in a bowl.
Dress with olive oil and lemon.

name: Turkey Avocado Lunch Wrap
steps: Spread sauce over the tortilla.
Fill with turkey, avocado, lettuce, and tomato, then roll tightly.

name: Vegan Chickpea Power Salad
steps: Toss chickpeas and vegetables in a bowl.
Whisk tahini with lemon and water, then drizzle over salad.

name: Salmon Cucumber Rice Bowl
steps: Cook salmon and flake into pieces.
Serve over rice with cucumber, edamame, avocado, and dressing.

name: Keto Chicken Caesar Salad Bowl
steps: Slice chicken over romaine.
Add avocado, parmesan, seeds, and dressing.

name: Vegan Tofu Soba Lunch Bowl
steps: Pan-sear tofu until golden.
Combine soba, vegetables, edamame, tofu, and sesame dressing.

name: Mediterranean Tuna Salad Sandwich
steps: Mix tuna with yogurt, celery, cucumber, and olive oil.
Serve between bread slices with extra greens if desired.

name: Vegan Lentil Brown Rice Bowl
steps: Warm lentils, rice, spinach, and carrots.
Top with olive oil and lemon tahini sauce.

name: Keto Turkey Lettuce Wraps
steps: Layer turkey, avocado, cucumber, and cheese into lettuce leaves.
Drizzle with herb sauce and roll.

name: Shrimp Pasta Salad Lunch
steps: Cook shrimp and pasta, then cool slightly.
Toss with arugula, tomatoes, olive oil, and lemon.

name: Vegan Black Bean Burrito Bowl
steps: Warm beans and rice.
Top with corn, salsa, avocado, and lettuce.

name: Keto Salmon Avocado Salad
steps: Cook salmon and place over greens.
Add avocado, cucumber, olive oil, and lemon.

name: Vegan Tempeh Crunch Sandwich
steps: Pan-sear sliced tempeh.
Build sandwich with hummus, vegetables, spinach, and tempeh.

name: Lean Beef Taco Salad Bowl
steps: Cook beef with taco spices.
Serve over lettuce with avocado, salsa, cheese, and yogurt.

name: Vegan Edamame Sushi Bowl
steps: Layer rice, edamame, cucumber, carrot, and avocado.
Top with sliced nori and soy sauce if desired.

name: Low-Carb Egg Salad Lunch Bowl
steps: Mash eggs with yogurt, celery, and mustard.
Serve over greens with avocado.

name: Chicken Pesto Pasta Lunch
steps: Toss warm pasta with pesto and spinach.
Add chicken, tomatoes, and parmesan.

name: Vegan Falafel Pita Lunch
steps: Warm pita and falafel.
Fill with hummus, falafel, cucumber, tomato, and lettuce.

name: Keto Tuna Avocado Boats
steps: Mix tuna with yogurt, celery, and lemon.
Spoon into avocado halves and serve with cucumber.

name: Vegan Peanut Tofu Wrap
steps: Pan-sear tofu strips.
Wrap tofu, vegetables, and peanut sauce in the tortilla.

name: Keto Shrimp Zoodle Bowl
steps: Cook shrimp and zucchini noodles briefly.
Toss with pesto, tomatoes, parmesan, and olive oil.

name: Vegan Mediterranean Mezze Box
steps: Pack hummus, chickpeas, pita, and vegetables into a container.
Add olives and lemon if desired.

name: Chicken Soba Salad Bowl
steps: Slice chicken and combine with soba and vegetables.
Toss with sesame ginger dressing.

name: Keto Cobb Lunch Bowl
steps: Arrange lettuce, chicken, egg, avocado, and cheese in a bowl.
Drizzle with vinaigrette.

name: Vegan White Bean Pasta Salad
steps: Toss pasta and beans with arugula and tomatoes.
Dress with olive oil and lemon.

name: Diabetes-Friendly Chicken Greek Salad
steps: Slice chicken over vegetables.
Add feta and olive oil, then toss.

name: Vegan Three Bean Lunch Wrap
steps: Mash beans lightly with salsa.
Wrap with lettuce in the tortilla.

name: Keto Chicken Caprese Bowl
steps: Slice chicken and mozzarella over arugula.
Add tomatoes, olive oil, and balsamic.

name: Vegan Tofu Caesar Wrap
steps: Pan-sear tofu until golden.
Wrap tofu, romaine, beans, dressing, and nutritional yeast.

name: Keto Mediterranean Meatball Salad
steps: Warm meatballs and place over salad vegetables.
Top with feta and olive oil.

name: Vegan High-Protein Bean Bowl
steps: Simmer beans, vegetable protein, and tomatoes with spices.
Serve over rice with avocado.

name: Keto Steak Power Salad
steps: Sear steak and mushrooms.
Serve over greens with avocado, cheese, and olive oil.

name: Vegan Roasted Vegetable Hummus Bowl
steps: Layer farro, hummus, roasted vegetables, and chickpeas.
Finish with olive oil and herbs.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Rice Bowl
steps: Steam broccoli and carrot.
Serve chicken and vegetables over rice with teriyaki and sesame.

name: Vegan Taco Salad Bowl
steps: Layer lettuce with beans, corn, salsa, and avocado.
Top with pumpkin seeds.

name: Keto Chicken Alfredo Zoodles
steps: Cook mushrooms and zucchini noodles briefly.
Toss with chicken, light cream, and parmesan.

name: Caprese Chickpea Sandwich
steps: Mash chickpeas lightly with pesto.
Build sandwich with mozzarella, tomato, arugula, and chickpeas.

name: Diabetes-Friendly Tofu Cauliflower Bowl
steps: Sear tofu and steam broccoli.
Serve over cauliflower rice with peanut sauce, sesame oil, and lime.

name: Harissa Chicken Flatbread Lunch
steps: Mix yogurt with harissa and spread over flatbread.
Top with chicken, cucumber, and tomato.

name: Vegan Quinoa Edamame Salad
steps: Toss quinoa, edamame, cabbage, and carrot.
Add sesame seeds and lime dressing.

name: Keto Pesto Turkey Lunch Bowl
steps: Cook turkey with zucchini and spinach.
Stir in pesto and top with parmesan and tomatoes.

name: Vegan Lentil Soup Lunch Box
steps: Simmer lentils, broth, vegetables, and tomatoes until thick.
Pack hot in a thermos or chill for later.

name: Chicken Hummus Sandwich
steps: Spread hummus on bread.
Add chicken, cucumber, tomato, and spinach.

name: Keto Halloumi Avocado Salad
steps: Pan-sear halloumi until golden.
Serve over greens with avocado, vegetables, and olive oil.

name: Vegan Poke-Style Lunch Bowl
steps: Cube tofu and combine with rice, edamame, cucumber, and avocado.
Top with sesame soy dressing.

name: Chicken Mango Salad Wrap
steps: Slice chicken and mango.
Wrap with lettuce, cucumber, and yogurt lime sauce.

name: Vegan Satay Rice Bowl
steps: Sear tofu and steam vegetables.
Serve over rice with satay sauce and lime.

name: Keto Chicken Cucumber Sushi Bowl
steps: Layer cucumber ribbons with chicken, avocado, and edamame.
Top with sesame and dressing.

name: Vegetarian Pesto Mozzarella Pasta
steps: Toss pasta with pesto and spinach.
Add mozzarella, tomatoes, and white beans.

name: Shrimp Taco Lunch Wraps
steps: Cook shrimp with spices.
Fill tortillas with shrimp, cabbage, avocado, salsa, and sauce.

name: Vegan Miso Chickpea Noodle Salad
steps: Toss noodles with chickpeas and vegetables.
Coat with miso sesame dressing.

name: Keto Salmon Cucumber Roll Bowl
steps: Flake salmon over cucumber and avocado.
Top with cream cheese, nori, and sesame.

name: Chicken Couscous Meal Prep Box
steps: Pack couscous, chicken, and vegetables into a container.
Top with olive oil and feta.

name: Vegan Green Goddess Grain Bowl
steps: Layer farro, edamame, spinach, cucumber, and avocado.
Drizzle with herb tahini sauce.

name: Keto Turkey Burger Salad
steps: Cook turkey patty and slice.
Serve over salad with avocado, cheese, tomato, and sauce.

name: Vegetarian Falafel Rice Bowl
steps: Warm falafel and rice.
Serve with hummus, cucumber, tomato, and lettuce.

name: Keto Prawn Avocado Salad
steps: Toss prawns with greens, cucumber, and avocado.
Dress with olive oil and lime.

name: Vegan Sweet Potato Black Bean Box
steps: Pack roasted sweet potato, beans, and spinach.
Top with salsa, avocado, and pumpkin seeds.

name: Chicken Barley Power Salad
steps: Combine barley, arugula, cucumber, and tomatoes.
Top with chicken and vinaigrette.

name: Vegan Bulgur Chickpea Tabouleh
steps: Toss bulgur, chickpeas, parsley, tomatoes, and cucumber.
Dress with olive oil and lemon.

name: Keto Egg Tuna Salad Plate
steps: Flake tuna and slice eggs.
Serve with greens, cucumber, olive oil, and dressing.

name: Vegan Balsamic Tofu Sandwich
steps: Sear tofu with balsamic vinegar.
Build sandwich with hummus, peppers, spinach, and tofu.

name: Chicken White Bean Soup Bowl
steps: Simmer chicken, beans, broth, and carrot until hot.
Stir in spinach and olive oil before serving.
